$description: Seafood Confidential · Working Waterfront design tokens v0.2 (2026-11-18: space, radius, elevation and motion added). Brand colors come from editorial/BRAND_GUIDE.md; derived steps were computed to meet WCAG 2.2 AA where the brand values do not. Single source for the project hub and the visual codex. Pending founder approval with the brand guide.

ink.$description: Masthead, primary text, dark covers, navigation

salt.$description: Main background, paper surfaces, light text on ink

sea-glass.$description: Secondary panels, rules, charts, quiet accents. Decorative on salt (2.36:1); text-capable on ink (5.43:1)

rust.$description: Small emphasis, selected labels, calls to action after contrast testing. 4.46:1 on salt: large text and accents only

paper-raised.$description: Card surface one step above salt

paper-recessed.$description: Table headers and recessed panels on salt

ink-muted.$description: Captions, metadata, axis labels on paper

rust-text.$description: Rust for small text on paper (5.37:1 on salt)

sea-text.$description: Sea glass for small text on paper (5.25:1 on salt)

harbor.$description: Links and primary chart marks on paper (6.52:1 on salt)

harbor-range.$description: Lighter step of harbor for estimate ranges; values always also in labels and table view

ink-raised.$description: Dark-theme recessed panels and table headers

sea-light.$description: Sea glass for text on ink (6.73:1)

harbor-light.$description: Links and chart marks on ink (6.90:1)

status.$description: Fixed status scale from the dataviz method; always paired with an icon and a label, never color alone.

contrast.$description: Pairs the hub build asserts. min 4.5 = normal text (WCAG 2.2 AA); 3 = large text or non-text UI.

pairs.use: Preview banner on the public site
Preview banner on the public site

display.$description: Strong editorial serif for masthead and headlines. OFL-1.1 (Undercase Type). Self-hosted variable font: opsz, wght, SOFT, WONK.

text.$description: Humanist sans for body and interface, including chart figures. OFL-1.1 (Adobe). Self-hosted variable font.

space.$description: Spacing scale on a 4px base: layout rhythm for the public site (v0.2). Compiled to --space-*.

elevation.$description: Neo-skeuomorphic depth (v0.2): one light from above, so every raised surface has a top highlight and layered ambient and key shadows, and recessed surfaces the reverse. Each theme sets its own highlight and shadow colours and strengths; components use --elevation-1/2/3, --elevation-inset and --elevation-bevel. Depth never replaces the 1px rule that marks a card's edge.

light.1: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-highlight) 70%, transparent), 0 1px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 7%, transparent), 0 3px 6px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 9%, transparent), 0 12px 24px -14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 24%, transparent)
light.2: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-highlight) 78%, transparent), 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 8%, transparent), 0 8px 16px -6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 15%, transparent), 0 26px 48px -22px color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 32%, transparent)
light.3: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-highlight) 85%, transparent), 0 2px 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 9%, transparent), 0 18px 34px -14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 22%, transparent), 0 52px 96px -36px color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 40%, transparent)
light.inset: inset 0 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 14%, transparent), inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-highlight) 65%, transparent)
light.bevel: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-highlight) 55%, transparent), inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 12%, transparent), 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 12%, transparent)

dark.1: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-highlight) 11%, transparent), 0 1px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 16%, transparent), 0 3px 6px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 21%, transparent), 0 12px 24px -14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 55%, transparent)
dark.2: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-highlight) 12%, transparent), 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 18%, transparent), 0 8px 16px -6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 34%, transparent), 0 26px 48px -22px color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 74%, transparent)
dark.3: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-highlight) 14%, transparent), 0 2px 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 21%, transparent), 0 18px 34px -14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 51%, transparent), 0 52px 96px -36px color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 92%, transparent)
dark.inset: inset 0 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 32%, transparent), inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-highlight) 10%, transparent)
dark.bevel: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-highlight) 9%, transparent), inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 28%, transparent), 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--elevation-shadow) 28%, transparent)

motion.$description: Motion for the public site (v0.2): GSAP ScrollTrigger for scroll-linked parallax and reveals, CSS for small transitions. Durations in ms, distances in px, parallax as a fraction of the scroll distance. A preset (data-motion on <html>: calm, standard, expressive) scales distance and speed; 'off', the reader's toggle and prefers-reduced-motion turn every animation off. Everything scroll-linked reverses when the reader scrolls back.
